stories.title: Brazilian artist Lucia Laguna dies at 85.
stories.sum: Brazilian painter Lucia Laguna , whose densely layered landscapes transformed the view from her Rio de Janeiro studio, has died at 85. She was one of the country’s most celebrated and distinctive contemporary artists.
